name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
summary: High Executor Derrington calls you to the Bulwark, east of Tirisfal Glade and the Undercity. Seek him out at his base camp.

sections.title: The Bulwark
sections.body: At the Bulwark, east of Tirisfal Glade and the Undercity, High Executor Derrington has a base camp. He is the one you are asked to seek out.

faq.answer: High Executor Derrington's base camp is at the Bulwark, east of Tirisfal Glade and the Undercity.
You are asked to seek out High Executor Derrington.
The Bulwark is east of Tirisfal Glade and the Undercity.
